question: According to the 69th Amendment Act of the Constitution of India, in which of the following years was Delhi declared as the National Capital Territory?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1991**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• With the 69th Constitutional Amendment, the capital city Delhi get a Legislative Assembly with the enactment of the National Capital Territory Act, 1991.
 
• 69th Amendment Constitutional Amendment Act of 1991 designated the Union Territory of Delhi as the National Capital Territory of Delhi. 
 
• The 69th Amendment act of the Indian Constitution granted special status to Delhi.
 
• In 1991, the amendment was passed and it granted a special state to Delhi and it was declared the National Capital Territory.
 
• It created a state assembly and council of ministers for the state. 
 
• Aditya Nath Jha became the first Lieutenant Governor of Delhi under the act.
 
• Article 239AA of the Constitution gave the status of Union Territory to Delhi.
